url.description: Page URL listed in the sitemap.

lastmod.description: The lastmod value from the sitemap (date or timestamp as published), or null.

changefreq.description: The changefreq hint from the sitemap, or null.

priority.description: The priority hint from the sitemap (0.0 to 1.0), or null.

imageCount.description: Number of image entries listed for this URL in the sitemap.

hreflang.description: Alternate-language links listed for this URL, each as {lang, url}. Empty if none.

sitemapUrl.description: The sitemap file this URL came from.

site.description: The start URL (website or sitemap) you gave, which this URL belongs to.

statusCode.description: HTTP status of the page. Null unless "Check HTTP status" is on, or if the request failed.

finalUrl.description: URL after redirects. Null unless "Check HTTP status" is on, or if the request failed.
